crossRefs.note: “When I had returned to Jerusalem, and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance,
but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the…
nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to…
He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
translations.bsb: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
translations.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
translations.asv: And when he was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: and they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
